qualification_rule: Exactly one forward destination, exactly one reverse destination returning the original source interval, same source/target interval length, and target chromosome in the allowed target panel.
length_changed_policy: Retain and classify; never count as same-coordinate base-level evidence.
target_annotation_policy: Do not read or compare any CHM13 annotation in this stage.
metric_policy: No F1, FP rescue, or annotation revision claim is computed here.
